task_snapshot.name: URL Shortener API
task_snapshot.description: Build a persistent URL shortener with click tracking.
functional_requirements: POST /links accepts JSON {"url": "https://...", "code": "optional-code"}. The url is required and must be an absolute http or https URL with a host. A custom code is optional; when omitted, generate a unique code. Codes contain 4 to 20 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
POST /links returns 201 JSON {"code": string, "url": string, "clicks": 0}. Return the submitted URL unchanged. A duplicate custom code returns 409 JSON with an error field.
GET /links/{code} returns 200 JSON {"code": string, "url": string, "clicks": integer}. Unknown codes return 404 JSON with an error field.
GET /r/{code} returns 302 with Location equal to the stored URL and increments clicks exactly once. Unknown codes return 404 JSON with an error field.
GET /links lists links in ascending creation order as 200 JSON {"items": [...], "total": integer}. Each item has the same fields as GET /links/{code}.
Malformed JSON, invalid or missing url, and invalid code return 422 JSON with an error field.
technical_requirements: Use the provided relational database and framework's idiomatic persistence layer. Read database settings from the environment; do not hard-code credentials.
Data and click counts must survive a server restart.

Provide an executable start.sh in the project root. `sh start.sh` must apply pending migrations and then serve the API in the foreground on 0.0.0.0:8000. Install dependencies while you work, not in start.sh.
Include a README section explaining how to start the server.
